title: A Passion in the Desert
author: Honoré de Balzac
description: "A Passion in the Desert" by Honoré de Balzac is a short story published in 1830.
longDescription: A French soldier, captured during Napoleon's Egyptian campaign, escapes into the desert where he finds refuge in a cave.

authorInfo.bio: Honoré de Balzac was a French novelist and playwright. The novel sequence La Comédie humaine, described as a panorama of post-Napoleonic French life, is generally viewed as his magnum opus.
